question: Alvaro has no cards in their library. They cast a [Merfolk Branchwalker]. As its enters-the-battlefield trigger resolves, what happens?
judge_answer: Alvaro can't reveal the top card of their library, so they put a +1/+1 counter on the Merfolk Branchwalker. Players only lose the game due to trying to draw a card from an empty library, not from trying to take some other action with it, so Alvaro does not lose the game.

question: Nico controls a [Mikaeus, the Unhallowed], [Daunting Defender], [Timber Protector], [Oakgnarl Warrior], [Goblin Outlander], and a 1/1 Vampire creature token. Agustin casts [Day of Judgment]. After everything has resolved, what creatures are on the battlefield?
judge_answer: Timber Protector, Oakgnarl Warrior and Goblin Outlander. Daunting Defender is a Human, regardless of what other creature types is has, so it does not have undying. Oakgnarl Warrior only loses indestructible after Timber Protector has left the battlefield, and all creatures are destroyed at the same time, so Oakgnarl Warrior is not destroyed. Protection does not prevent a permanent from being destroyed, so Goblin Outlander dies. It's not a Human, so it has undying and returns to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.

question: Alison controls [Duskwatch Recruiter] enchanted by [Infinite Reflection]. Alison also controls a [Convicted Killer] which is currently a copy of Duskwatch Recruiter. No spells were cast last turn. At the beginning of their upkeep, what happens to the Duskwatch Recruiter and Convicted Killer?
judge_answer: Both Duskwatch Recruiter and Convicted Killer transform. Convicted Killer's back face remains a copy of the front face of Duskwatch Recruiter.

question: Alexandra controls [Riot Devils] enchanted with [Black Ward]. Nikolai controls [Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts]. Alexandra attacks with Riot Devils and it isn't blocked. After combat damage has been dealt, does Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts's ability trigger and destroy Riot Devils?
judge_answer: Yes. After combat damage has been dealt Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts's ability triggers, and when it resolves it will destroy Riot Devils. The protection granted by Black Ward doesn't prevent destruction. Protection means that the permanent can't be damaged, targeted, enchanted, or blocked by anything with the quality protection refers to.

question: Anakin activates [Golden Guardian]'s ability, targeting [Dralnu, Lich Lord]. As the ability resolves and Dralnu, Lich Lord would be dealt 4 damage, they choose to sacrifice the Golden Guardian and 3 other permanents instead. Will the Golden Guardian return to the battlefield?
judge_answer: No. Spells and abilities carry out their instructions in the order written, so the fight occurs first, then the delayed trigger to return it to the battlefield is created. Normally Golden Guardian would die as state-based actions were checked after the ability finished resolving, so the trigger to return it to the battlefield would already be in existence. However since Dralnu, Lich Lord replaces the damage with sacrificing permanents, Golden Guardian dies as the fight occurs. The delayed triggered ability to return it to the battlefield is only created after the Golden Guardian has already died, so it will never have a chance to trigger.

question: Nicole controls a [Doubling Season]. Aspen casts [Chatter of the Squirrel]. In response, Nicole casts [Gather Specimens]. Who creates how many tokens?
judge_answer: Nicole creates 2 tokens. At first there is no effect that modifies how the tokens are created, so the effect from Gather Specimens that modifies how they enter the battlefield is applied. Now that they are entering under Nicole's control, Doubling Season's effect becomes applicable and modifies how they are created. It doesn't matter that Doubling Season applies to the creation of the tokens while Gather Specimens applies to them entering the battlefield- it's still the same event.

question: Amira casts [Tidal Wave]. In response, Nico casts [Gather Specimens]. In response, Amira casts [Crafty Cutpurse]. Who gets the token?
judge_answer: Amira does. There is only one replacement effect applying to the original event, (Gather Specimens's) so it's applied. That causes Crafty Cutpurse's effect to become applicable, and the token goes back to being created under Amira's control. Gather Specimens won't apply again. It doesn't matter that Crafty Cutpurse applies to the creation of the tokens while Crafty Cutpurse applies to them entering the battlefield- it's still the same event.

question: Ashley controls [Ulrich of the Krallenhorde] enchanted by [Infinite Reflection]. Ashley also controls an [Instigator Gang] which is currently a copy of Ulrich of the Krallenhorde. Ashley casts [Waxing Moon] targeting Instigator Gang. What happens?
judge_answer: Instigator Gang transforms. Instigator Gang's back face remains a copy of Ulrich of the Krallenhorde. Instigator Gang's trigger that triggers "whenever it transforms into Ulrich of the Krallenhorde" triggers.

question: Ashley casts [Desperate Ritual] and would like to use the mana it generates to splice another Desperate Ritual onto it. Can they do this?
judge_answer: No. Ashley chooses whether they are splicing anything onto Desperate Ritual and then pays its cost as Desperate Ritual is cast. It only resolves and adds {R}{R}{R} afterwards.

question: Aliana controls [Hazezon Tamar] and [Bloodline Pretender]. Nikolai casts [Unlicensed Disintegration] targeting Hazezon Tamar. Does Bloodline Pretender get exiled by Hazezon Tamar's trigger?
judge_answer: Yes. It's a Sand and a Warrior.

question: Addison controls [Carth the Lion] and [Bioessence Hydra]. Addison activates the [+1] ability of [Dovin, Architect of Law]. How many times does Bioessence Hydra trigger?
judge_answer: Once. If a planeswalker's ability has multiple costs to add or remove loyalty counters, those costs are combined into a single cost.
